Name: EBAGI - PokeCrops Artisan Goods Icons
Author: Meowdoleon
Description:
As base game now have multiple colors for artisan goods, I thought I would add official support for PokeCrops.

[size=5]Installation:
[/size][size=4]Vanilla SMAPI:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Install[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2065] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2065]PokeCrops [/url]﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720][/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip "[EBAGI] PokeCrops Artisan Goods Icons" folder in your "Mods" folder[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4]Stardrop:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]
[*]Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2065]PokeCrops[/url]﻿ through Stardrop
[*]Unzip "[EBAGI] PokeCrops Artisan Goods Icons" folder in your Stardrop Installed Mods folder, or drag and drop the zipped file into the Stardrop application
[*]Activate [EBAGI] PokeCrops Artisan Goods Icons in Stardrop
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility:
[/size]This will soft conflict with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5220]SCAGI[/url] as PokeCrops 1.0 is supported by Cheerybelle. I can only guarantee that the artisan goods for the berries added after 1.0 will have their icons changed﻿, the rest will depends in what order SMAPI decides to load in the mods. If you want SCAGI for other mods, delete the [BAGI] SCAGI - Pokecrops folder.
It might however works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20755]SCAGI Lite[/url], as that uses the﻿ vanilla coding to apply colors to icons. More testing is needed however.
As [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22097]Peachy Objects 1.6 items variation[/url] uses the same base as SCAGI Lite, it should﻿ behave in the same ways.
